title: Everest to the Galaxy
styleReference: Cinematic realism in three.js: physically inspired light, one continuous camera journey from Everest to the Milky Way, transitions through cloud, smoke, haze, and scale. No cuts, no text, no logos.

scenes.title: The Roof of the World
scenes.logline: At sunrise a drone glides toward Everest above a sea of clouds, golden light on the summit, snow blowing off the ridges; it passes just over the peak and rises into the sky.
scenes.props: snow; glaciers; blowing snow; thin clouds; golden sunrise light; wind

scenes.title: Fire and Earth
scenes.logline: Through the clouds a colossal active volcano appears over black lava fields; glowing lava flows down its slopes, the crater bubbles, and the camera sweeps around it and rises through the towering plume.
scenes.props: lava flows; bubbling crater; smoke plume; ash particles; black lava fields; fire glow

scenes.title: Earth From Above
scenes.logline: The smoke becomes cloud as the camera climbs to the edge of space; Earth's curve, oceans, continents, cloud systems and thin blue glow appear, the night side lit by cities, until the whole planet hangs in the dark.
scenes.props: atmosphere glow; clouds; oceans; continents; city lights; day and night

scenes.title: Leaving Earth
scenes.logline: Beyond the atmosphere the sky turns black; the Moon and satellites appear, stars come out, and Earth shrinks beneath the camera as it accelerates gently into space.
scenes.props: the Moon; satellites; stars; sunlight on Earth

scenes.title: The Solar System
scenes.logline: The Sun blazes as the camera travels past Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter's storms, Saturn's rings, and the blue giants Uranus and Neptune.
scenes.props: the Sun; Mercury; Venus; Mars; Jupiter; Saturn's rings; Uranus; Neptune

scenes.title: The Milky Way
scenes.logline: The solar system becomes a speck and the Milky Way spreads out, spiral arms of stars, pink nebulae, dark dust lanes and a golden core, as the camera rises and pulls back to a gentle stop.
scenes.props: spiral arms; nebulae; dust lanes; the galactic core; star clusters
